description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to amend the rate of cess in respect of Waters, etc., w.e.f. 24.08.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order amending the rate of cess (a tax) under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979. It involves regulatory changes to financial/commercial levies through statutory authority, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure announcement. While a minister is named, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to amend regulations, not announcing a personnel change or detailing ministerial portfolios.
